"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"A profile directory holds:"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"| File | Purpose |"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"| `package.json` | Profile manifest: `dsh.profile.bundles` lists the ordered plugin bundles to mount"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"; `dependencies` holds out-of-tree plugins |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Your own patch layer, applied af"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"ter every bundle layer |
| `pnpm-workspace.yaml` | pnpm settings for the profile; the `allowBuilds` "},{"id":"p30s4","text":"key goes here |
| `node_modules` | pnpm-managed plugin dependencies |"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"There is **no default profile** — `dsh --profile <name>` is required on every run (`dsh web` is a sh"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"orthand for `dsh --profile web`).
